limitations: Exploratory cell-level associations; shared datasets and seeds are not independent subjects.
Tail exclusion changes the sample and range; correlation changes do not quantify a causal contribution.
Group centering removes profile/dataset offsets only; it does not remove all confounding.
Train/test prediction differences mix data and model-mode effects; they cannot isolate dropout.
The fixed-architecture target/loss intervention has not run; no accuracy improvement is established.
